style_suffix: Wide landscape banner composition with the single main subject centered in the horizontal middle band of the frame and generous negative space around it. Style: premium enterprise editorial illustration, modern 3D-rendered minimalism, matte surfaces, deep navy and teal color palette (deep teal #0d5967, navy #1a365d) with one warm coral-red accent (#e53e3e) used sparingly, soft studio lighting, subtle depth of field, clean uncluttered professional composition, calm authoritative mood.
